name: Ardor3D PlyImporter
reason: Javadoc documents a PLY reader; a pinned published open-source artifact and ASCII control run remain unchecked.

name: ArtiSynth Maspack PlyReader
reason: The official 3.9 ZIP includes PlyReader source and compiled classes and a local-file API; a temporary control run parsed the ASCII triangle. However, its distribution LICENSE documents bundled TetGen restricted to noncommercial use. A separately released BSD-only Maspack PLY reader package has not been established, so the mixed-license distribution is not counted as an open-source package path.
